items.text:
ॐ आपदामपहर्तारं दातारं सर्वसम्पदाम्।
लोकाभिरामं श्रीरामं भूयो भूयो नमाम्यहम्॥
items.tr:
oṃ āpadāmapahartāraṃ dātāraṃ sarvasampadām|
lokābhirāmaṃ śrīrāmaṃ bhūyo bhūyo namāmyaham||
items.en: Om. Again and again I bow to Shri Rama, who takes away troubles, gives every kind of wealth, and delights the world.

items.text:
आर्तानामार्तिहन्तारं भीतानां भीतिनाशनम्।
द्विषतां कालदण्डं तं रामचन्द्रं नमाम्यहम्॥
items.tr:
ārtānāmārtihantāraṃ bhītānāṃ bhītināśanam|
dviṣatāṃ kāladaṇḍaṃ taṃ rāmacandraṃ namāmyaham||
items.en: I bow to Ramachandra, who ends the pain of the suffering, destroys the fear of the frightened, and is the rod of death for enemies.

items.text:
नमः कोदण्डहस्ताय सन्धीकृतशराय च।
खण्डिताखिलदैत्याय रामायापन्निवारिणे॥
items.tr:
namaḥ kodaṇḍahastāya sandhīkṛtaśarāya ca|
khaṇḍitākhiladaityāya rāmāyāpannivāriṇe||
items.en: Salutation to Rama, who holds the bow Kodanda with the arrow set on it, who cut down all the demons, and who wards off danger.

items.text:
रामाय रामभद्राय रामचन्द्राय वेधसे।
रघुनाथाय नाथाय सीतायाः पतये नमः॥
items.tr:
rāmāya rāmabhadrāya rāmacandrāya vedhase|
raghunāthāya nāthāya sītāyāḥ pataye namaḥ||
items.en: Salutation to Rama, the gracious Rama, Ramachandra, the creator, lord of the Raghus, the Lord, the husband of Sita.

items.text:
अग्रतः पृष्ठतश्चैव पार्श्वतश्च महाबलौ।
आकर्णपूर्णधन्वानौ रक्षेतां रामलक्ष्मणौ॥
items.tr:
agrataḥ pṛṣṭhataścaiva pārśvataśca mahābalau|
ākarṇapūrṇadhanvānau rakṣetāṃ rāmalakṣmaṇau||
items.en: May Rama and Lakshmana, mighty and with bows drawn back to the ear, protect me in front, behind and on both sides.

items.text:
सन्नद्धः कवची खड्गी चापबाणधरो युवा।
गच्छन्ममाग्रतो नित्यं रामः पातु सलक्ष्मणः॥
items.tr:
sannaddhaḥ kavacī khaḍgī cāpabāṇadharo yuvā|
gacchanmamāgrato nityaṃ rāmaḥ pātu salakṣmaṇaḥ||
items.en: May young Rama, ready for battle, in armour, with sword, bow and arrows, always walking ahead of me, protect me together with Lakshmana.

items.text:
अच्युतानन्तगोविन्दनामोच्चारणभेषजात्।
नश्यन्ति सकला रोगास्सत्यं सत्यं वदाम्यहम्॥
items.tr:
acyutānantagovindanāmoccāraṇabheṣajāt|
naśyanti sakalā rogāssatyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmyaham||
items.en: By the medicine of saying the names Achyuta, Ananta and Govinda, all diseases are destroyed. I say this truly, truly.

items.text:
सत्यं सत्यं पुनस्सत्यमुद्धृत्य भुजमुच्यते।
वेदाच्छास्त्रं परं नास्ति न देवः केशवात्परः ॥
items.tr:
satyaṃ satyaṃ punassatyamuddhṛtya bhujamucyate|
vedācchāstraṃ paraṃ nāsti na devaḥ keśavātparaḥ ||
items.en: Truth, truth and again truth, said with the arm raised: there is no scripture higher than the Veda, and no God higher than Keshava.

items.text:
शरीरे जर्ज्जरीभूते व्याधिग्रस्ते कलेवरे।
औषधं जाह्नवीतोयं वैद्यो नारायणो हरिः॥
items.tr:
śarīre jarjjarībhūte vyādhigraste kalevare|
auṣadhaṃ jāhnavītoyaṃ vaidyo nārāyaṇo hariḥ||
items.en: When the body is worn out and gripped by disease, the medicine is the water of the Ganga, and the physician is Narayana, Hari.

items.text:
आलोड्य सर्वशास्त्राणि विचार्य च पुनः पुनः।
इदमेकं सुनिष्पन्नं ध्येयो नारायणो हरिः ॥
items.tr:
āloḍya sarvaśāstrāṇi vicārya ca punaḥ punaḥ|
idamekaṃ suniṣpannaṃ dhyeyo nārāyaṇo hariḥ ||
items.en: After studying all the scriptures and thinking again and again, this one conclusion is clear: Narayana, Hari, is the one to meditate on.

items.text:
यदक्षरपदभ्रष्टं मात्राहीनं तु यद्भवेत्।
तत्सर्व क्षम्यतां देव नारायण नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
items.tr:
yadakṣarapadabhraṣṭaṃ mātrāhīnaṃ tu yadbhavet|
tatsarva kṣamyatāṃ deva nārāyaṇa namo'stu te ||
items.en: O God Narayana, forgive whatever syllable or word was missed, or any sound left short. Salutation to you.

items.text:
विसर्गबिन्दुमात्राणि पदपादाक्षराणि च।
न्यूनानि चातिरिक्तानि क्षमस्व पुरुषोत्तम ॥
items.tr:
visargabindumātrāṇi padapādākṣarāṇi ca|
nyūnāni cātiriktāni kṣamasva puruṣottama ||
items.en: O Supreme Person, forgive any visargas, nasal marks, sound lengths, words, verse-quarters or syllables that were too few or too many.
